assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's one curated REVIEWED item at basis_commit, read end to end with its front matter: the canonical character monograph series/fx-fighter-kurumi-chan/characters/yamashi-mebuki-manga.md (FXK-P006, version 1.0, 81,398 bytes, status canonical), a self-contained portrait of Yamashi Mebuki within the Japanese collected manga main narrative V01-V10 to V10 i0156 (24 April 2017), located by volume and page occurrence (Vnn iNNNN) and by the project's observation, decision-episode, claim and open-question IDs (FXK-Vnn-Ennn, FXK-Vnn-Dnnn, FXK-Vnn-Cnnn, FXK-SYN-Cnnn, Vnn-Unn), with brief Japanese quotations. Its publication note records an independent self-containment PASS and a fidelity PASS after revision; it re-opened thirty pages (section 15). She is named offstage in V01, on the page from V02 i0004, and absent from the V09 2017 coda and from V10. Covers, flaps, afterwords, under-jacket notes, later volumes and adaptations are excluded by the monograph itself. The volume readings, the decision and evidence ledger, Studies B and C and the audits it cites are not curated on this subject, and no claim rests on them directly; where the monograph reports a study's argument, the claim rests on the monograph's report. No primary source page was inspected for this assessment.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Her story time from April 2014 to autumn 2015 within V01-V10, in located states: April 2014, the language-class meeting with Mochiko (the V05 i0051 flashback; late revelation, so the origin and her first motive belong to her at every later state); V02 (late May to 15 July 2014), the delegating beginner, 200,000 to 613,200円; V03 (13 August to October 2014), split at the 13 August wipe-out (i0042, i0049), at the September tuition deposit against her mother's refusal (i0028-i0029, i0058), at the two refused exits of 15 October (21:30 and 22:28, i0127-i0131), and at Mochiko's lie in answer to her direct question (i0147-i0148); V04 (31 October to November 2014), split at the forced close and same-night re-entry (i0012-i0028), at the 109.5% loan with her parents' address and number as security (i0103-i0119), and at the night disclosure to Yasuko (i0129-i0139), with the salon hire (i0146); V05 (17 November to early December 2014), the borrowed-money rescue shorts, split at the overheard truth about Mochiko's position (i0144-i0146); V06 (5 December 2014), split at the broker's forced liquidation (i0039) and the relief and turn to work that follow (i0040-i0044); V07 (25 December 2014), the contest result, partial disclosure and Mochiko's admission (i0012-i0019); V08 (January 2015, a flashback at the salon); V09 (early February 2015 and autumn 2015: near repayment and a new domestic account with a rand position). The V04 'キラキラ' motive (i0135) and the V05 origin are late revelation of a motive already acting in V02, not development. What the page never shows her learning (how Kurumi's mother died, Mochiko's private contempt, Yasuko's 2013 history, the full extent of Kurumi's crisis beyond Mochiko's January account) stays unknown to her in every state. Nothing after autumn 2015 is evidence about her: she does not appear in 2017.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution) and the owner's A/B boundary direction of 24 November 2026 in PR #694, not yet recorded in the policy: A turns on the integration, individuation and transferability of the model within a declared scope; interpretations that predict the same behavior may coexist; divergent transfer conditions, missing evidence and unsettled dispositions are named and excluded rather than counted against the tier; held-out validation, analytical derivation, relationship labels and preserved source chronology are not barriers. Evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Sections 4, 5 and 13 give values and goals (belonging to a bright, winning group and being seen as capable in it, V04 i0135, V07 i0014-i0015; money without work early, V02 i0056; a craft and a shop of her own after the ruin, V07 i0009), a governing fear (her parents burdened and knowing, V04 i0118, i0128), vulnerabilities (a voice that licenses what she already wants; a reference point that moves to her suffering, V03 i0127-i0131; worth fused with results; shame) and a decision model with its driver: belonging and a borrowed authority (Study C SC-1, as the monograph reports it), a break-even reference that sizes her positions (V03 i0059; V05 i0061, i0085-i0087), and insight that is accurate and inert in the moment (FXK-V03-C005; V04 i0107). The account discriminates: her response changes with whether a trade is winning or losing, whether money or credit is still reachable, whether the voice is a trusted authority or a friend she ranks below her, whether her family might learn, and whether she is before or after the 5 December liquidation (section 13). It predicts her mistakes: holding past a named point, refusing the 15 October exits, same-night re-entry on credit, asking whether she can win rather than whether she should, contempt for Yasuko's warning, the accusation of Kurumi, and the restart before repayment. Not A: the evidence cannot separate deference to authority from deference to whatever licenses holding (she kept the short after learning the truth, V05 i0145 to V06 i0039, and what she would have done on 15 October had she known is unshown, V03-U05), so a novel case where an authority advises an exit is not discriminated; the monograph says the page supplies behaviour more securely than mechanism; whether her change after V06 was development or release is unsettled. Not C: the conditions that change her choices are located and stated, with counterexamples (the modest V05 exits, i0065-i0066; the refused wage deposit, i0102).

Section 12 dates real change with causes as the page shows them: attitude to work (V02 i0056 to V06 i0042 and V07 i0009, after the broker's close and relief, V06 i0040); disclosure (lies to Yasuko and her mother, then the V04 night disclosure without the loan's terms or security, the wipe-out to her creditor, V06 i0051, partial truth at Christmas); the tie to Mochiko (idolization to informed gratitude and teasing equality, V07 i0018-i0019, V08 i0103-i0110); the tie to Kurumi (dependence, resentment, goodwill); and self-understanding (luck attributions to self-blame and a model of her own cognition, V07 i0014, V08 i0107). It states what persists (the appetite and the wish to trade together, V09 i0114-i0117) and keeps late revelation apart from development (the V04 motive, the V05 origin, Mochiko's contempt, the parents' opposition reported in V07). Not A: the post-crisis states are lightly sampled (one V07 evening, one V08 flashback, a few V09 scenes), the cause of the change toward Kurumi is not stated (INFERENCE MODERATE), whether her trading process changed is UNRESOLVED (V09-U06), and she is absent after autumn 2015. Not C: the states are located to the day across 2014 and their transitions are tied to page events.

Section 7 constrains her written Japanese: Kansai-type forms (ねん, やろ, ほんま, あかん, 〜へん, 〜てまう, ちゃう) in her inner voice and at home; polite standard です/ます to Kurumi and Mochiko as 先輩, customers and strangers; わたくし once on a formal call (V04 i0117); 私 throughout; address forms dated by listener (萌智子先輩, くるみ先輩, やす子ちゃん, お母さん, お父さん, 健斗), and the change of Mochiko's form to her as an event (V07 i0018). The switch tracks inner against outer voice as well as concealment (FXK-V03-C021; FXK-V04-C027; V03 i0083-i0084; V04 i0135, i0139). Her vocabulary is dated by period (V02 trader-gamer exuberance; V03-V05 game, survival and prayer lexicon and '養分'; V08 service katakana), with the masked assent 'ウン… ソウダネ…' (V03 i0088). A written transfer test supports bounded use: in a 2014 trading state, a polite outward line to a senior over a Kansai thought about the position is predicted by both explanations of the switch. Not A: the pressure exception, Kansai aloud to the seniors under bravado, rests on two instances, one of them a MODERATE attribution (V03 i0095, i0120), so the evidence does not say what level of pressure or information flips her outward register in a new scene; her inner voice after the crisis is unsettled (standard at V07 i0014 before Kansai at i0015; no Kansai lettered in V08); whether the V03 i0084 lines to Yasuko are speech or thought is unresolved; her V09 speech is a small sample. Not C: the forms, the switch and its triggers are located across V02-V09 with anchors.

Sections 6 and 9 give ordinary conduct across volumes: food from home as comfort and barometer (V03 i0076-i0077; V04 i0009), a snack hoard she calls '非常食' (V03 i0083), grilled meat and beer and eating freely (V07 i0006; V09 i0088), arcade dance games with Yasuko (V02 i0075-i0079), games and gacha as her scale of value, cute animal things, her outdoor clothes, habits (the laptop plugged in the wrong way, the horoscope, cutting her own bangs when she cannot afford the salon, wages kept in cash in an envelope), and procedural conduct at work (pointing-and-calling, exact timing, self-coaching, an option sold; V06 i0016-i0017, i0042; V08 i0097-i0109). Situational choices (one meal a day, 871円, the salon chosen under pressure) are kept apart from preferences, and aversions are stated. Not A: many habits rest on one instance, her university life is thin, and her ordinary life after early 2015 is barely shown. Not C: the habits recur across settings and volumes with locators.

Section 8 reads each tie in both directions and dates it: Mochiko (idolization; the direct question and the lie, V03 i0144-i0148; grateful debtor who asks whether she can win, V04 i0107; faith kept until the overheard truth, V05 i0143-i0146; the report of ruin and deferred reproach, V06 i0051-i0053; deception and gratitude held together, V07 i0018-i0019; teasing equality and pressure to help Kurumi, V08 i0103-i0110); Kurumi (dependence, rivalry and private ill-wishes, supplication turned to accusation and withdrawal, V04 i0069-i0073, then goodwill and a fierce mistaken defence, V09 i0095); Yasuko (protective lie, contempt and apology, V03 i0049-i0050, i0142-i0143; the night disclosure with its withheld parts, V04 i0129-i0139; easy banter later); her family (concealment ranked above her solvency, the lenient parent reached first, V06 i0044); and customers and strangers. Conduct is conditioned on the other's standing as she ranks it, on whose voice licenses holding, on her own fortunes and on what each knows. Not A: the cause of the change toward Kurumi is INFERENCE MODERATE, no present exchange with her family after V03 is shown in content, her reproach to Mochiko is never voiced, and Kizuna, Nana and the 2017 circle are unsampled. Not C: her conduct varies by relationship in located, explained ways.

Thought balloons and unballooned thought, many on re-opened pages, give her interior at each major decision: the duty to win the money back (V03 i0074), the fear of being the only loser (V03 i0088), the two refused exits (V03 i0127-i0131), the private ill-wishes toward Kurumi (V03 i0108, i0124), the overridden reconsideration at the moment of borrowing (V04 i0107), the self-correction about burdening her parents (V04 i0128), resignation (V05 i0102), relief (V06 i0040-i0042), self-blame and gratitude held unspoken (V07 i0014-i0019). The monograph keeps SELF_REPORT apart from the series' own view of her, and her own after-the-fact model of her cognition is labelled (V08 i0107). Not A: interior is sparse in V08-V09; some attributions rest on balloon placement (V03 i0120, MODERATE); and pages that make a danger to her person salient give no stated intention, so that interior is not established (V04 i0122; V06 i0025). Not C: her reasons at the turning points are lettered, not inferred.

The monograph locates her conflict modes: mostly inward; contempt toward a friend she ranks below her who warns her, then thanks and an apology as she leaves (V03 i0142-i0143); polite supplication to a refusing friend turned to accusation and then polite withdrawal (V04 i0069-i0073); no confrontation with the person who deceived her: work, pay, defer the reproach until the debt is paid (V06 i0053); storming from the family table (V03 i0029); a fierce polite confrontation of a stranger on a friend's behalf, mistaken, followed by an apology (V09 i0095-i0097). Not B: each mode rests on one or two scenes, and the reproach she defers to Mochiko is never voiced on the page, so how she would conduct an open confrontation on her own behalf once free of the debt, a central conflict of her arc, is not established; that is insufficiency, not uncertainty of wording. Not D: each mode is located with its trigger.

Her moral reasoning is located in a few scenes: responsibility first as a duty to win the money back for her family (V03 i0074); the knowing self-correction that concealment does not spare her parents, followed by concealment (V04 i0128); responsibility taken readily with others, even where it is not hers (the apology to Yasuko, V04 i0136; honesty with a customer about a hunch and an apology in advance, V06 i0035; owning the debt, V06 i0053; self-blame rather than blame of Mochiko, V07 i0014); one boundary held under her lender's pressure (no night work, V04 i0103, i0116); and decency intact at her worst (the seat offered, V04 i0031). She never says 自己責任 of herself. The discovery row claims no ethics dimension, and this grade claims no broader moral or political reasoning. Not B: weighing of obligations is staged only at the ticket machine, and her holding of deception and gratitude together (V07 i0018-i0019) is a stance whose reasons beyond the page's words are not given. Not D: the reasoning in each located case is on the page and consistent across them.

Sections 4, 6 and 7 document play as coping and as affection: money turned into a game ('死亡ライン', '残り寿命(ライフ)', V03 i0072-i0073, i0109), plans turned into heroic fantasy (the '救い玉作戦' in a mage's costume, V05 i0063), comic grievance at the Christmas dinner (V07 i0003-i0005), self-mockery ('400万円の… 焼き肉やね…', V07 i0012), gleeful ruling for a loophole (V07 i0025), and teasing her creditor as the loan-shark type to her face (V08 i0108). Not B: much of her comedy is drawn (gag faces, the taped laptop), and the evidence describes a style and its coping function by example without establishing when play gives way to panic or seriousness in a new scene. Not D: the style is specific and located across volumes.

The curated monograph covers every appearance within the V01-V10 boundary (named offstage in V01, the centre of V03-V04, absent from the 2017 coda and V10), reconciles her figure chain against the longitudinal audit (section 2), re-opened thirty pages to verify quotations and attributions (section 15), and passed independent self-containment and fidelity checks. Its claims carry locators and graded labels, and its operational profile carries support grades and counterconditions. Not A: the assessment rests on one derived portrait, and the readings, ledger, studies and audits that carry the underlying observations are not curated on this subject. Not C: coverage of the admitted boundary is comprehensive rather than sampled.

The monograph states affirmative limits: no stop order is shown in any of her positions, and the two account-ending closes whose mechanism is shown were made by the broker (V04 i0012; V06 i0039); her failures are not ignorance of risk (FXK-V03-C005); the one stop she made herself while money remained was resignation, and she kept the position (V05 i0102); learning the truth about Mochiko did not make her close (V05 i0145 to V06 i0039); she never voices her reproach to Mochiko and is never shown asking for an apology; she never says 自己責任 of herself; she refuses night work under pressure (V04 i0103, i0116); the pages that make a danger to her person salient carry no stated intention, plan or act (section 6); and section 13 gives counterconditions and an abstention list. Not A: some limits rest on what the page does not show (her parents' knowledge, the rand position's fate) rather than contrary conduct. Not C: the limits are stated affirmatively and located.

States carry dates and locators: April 2014 (V05 i0051); late May to 15 July 2014 (V02); 13 August 2014; September and October 2014, with the two exits of 15 October at 21:30 and 22:28 (V03 i0127-i0131); 31 October and 3 November (V04); 17 November to early December (V05); 5 December (V06); 25 December 2014 (V07); January 2015 (V08); early February and autumn 2015 (V09); her age 20 captioned once (V02 i0004). Section 2 tabulates her course with money by sign, unit and provenance, and section 3 keeps disclosure order apart from story order. Not A: the 2015 states are dated only to month or season, the time of Mochiko's close is unprinted, and nothing after autumn 2015 is dated for her. Not C: the 2014 chronology is explicit and fine-grained.

conditions: Output is illustrative written Japanese, never quotation; her voice is lettering, so no accent, pitch or performed delivery is claimed (section 7, The medium's limits).
Self-reference is 私; わたくし only on a formal call; ウチ for her home, not as a first-person pronoun.

Register follows the listener and the inner-outer rule: polite standard です/ます to Kurumi and Mochiko as 先輩, customers and strangers; Kansai-type forms in thought, at home with her family, and in banter with Yasuko, with standard in serious talk with Yasuko; a Kansai thought may run under a polite outward line in the 2014 trading states.

Address follows the listener: 萌智子先輩, くるみ先輩, やす子ちゃん, お母さん, お父さん, 健斗. Mochiko's switch to the bare 芽吹 at V07 i0017 is something she remarks on as closeness (i0018); it does not change her own forms of address.
Vocabulary follows the state: V02 trader-gamer exuberance; V03-V05 game, survival, hero-fantasy and prayer lexicon and '養分' for herself; V08 service and business katakana.

Kansai aloud to the seniors under bravado is a lower-confidence condition (two instances, one MODERATE attribution); her inner register after the crisis is unsettled (V07 i0014-i0015; no Kansai in V08) and is not asserted either way.

The interlocutor is Kurumi, Mochiko, Yasuko, her family, a customer or a stranger; another peer is a separate, lower-confidence condition limited to the register rules. Nothing set after autumn 2015 is generated as her speech.
scenario_readiness.note: The inner-outer rule, register by listener, dated address forms and period vocabulary constrain illustrative written Japanese closely enough for bounded use. Not READY: the evidence is lettering, the pressure exception is thinly sampled, her post-crisis inner register is unsettled, and her V09 speech is a small sample. Not NOT_READY: the forms and their triggers are located across V02-V09.

conditions: A losing position in a 2014 trading state (V03 to the 5 December liquidation) with money or credit still reachable: predict holding, a correct computation of the danger said aloud, rituals, prayer or self-mockery, defence with more money from funds first labelled as protected, and an exit set at break-even that moves with her suffering and with others' gains (section 13, HIGH).

Counterconditions in the same states: when a gain pays for it she may take a modest exit (V05 i0065-i0066); she may refuse to deposit more out of resignation while keeping the position (V05 i0102). After a forced close with credit reachable, same-night re-entry framed as recovery is observed once (V04 i0012-i0028) and is MODERATE as a pattern, not a certain next act.

A trusted authority reassures her: predict holding and a question whether she can win rather than whether she should (V04 i0107). Abstain on what she does if a trusted authority advises an exit: the evidence does not separate deference to authority from deference to what licenses holding (V03-U05; V05 i0145 to V06 i0039).

A friend she ranks below her warns her, or a friend refuses her, in a 2014 trading state: contempt or accusation, then apology or polite withdrawal (two scenes, V03 i0142-i0143, V04 i0069-i0073; MODERATE-HIGH). No such scene after V06; in V09 she takes Yasuko's refusal of the rand cheerfully.

Her family might learn, V03-V06: predict concealment ranked above her solvency (HIGH); reaching first for the lenient parent is one instance (V06 i0044). What she told them is unknown and is not generated.

Learning she was deceived, from the overheard truth in early December (V05 i0145-i0146) through Mochiko's admission (V07 i0017-i0019): collapse, then no confrontation; work and payment, judgement deferred until the debt is paid, deception and gratitude held together (HIGH, V05-V07). At salon work, from November 2014: polite, procedural, honest about uncertainty and firm about time (MODERATE-HIGH, V05-V08).

From V07 on: a friend in danger draws action on what she knows, which may be wrong (V08 i0105-i0110; V09 i0092-i0097; two scenes). With spare money after hardship (autumn 2015) she wants to trade again with company and reassures others she has a plan (one scene; outcome abstained).

Include her mistakes: holding past a named point, the refused 15 October exits, borrowing at 109.5% while thinking it will fail, the luck attributions and the reading of Kurumi's survival as a cheat, the accusation of Kurumi in ignorance of her history, contempt for Yasuko's warning, the mistaken confrontation of Kurumi's father, and the restart before repayment.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state from the temporal boundary: V02 (late May to 15 July 2014); V03 before or after the 13 August wipe-out, the September tuition deposit, the 15 October exits or the lie of i0147-i0148; V04 before or after the 31 October close, the loan of i0103-i0119 or the night disclosure; V05 before or after the overheard truth (i0145); V06 before or after the 5 December liquidation; V07 (25 December 2014); V08 (January 2015); V09 (early February or autumn 2015). The April 2014 origin and the 'キラキラ' motive belong to her at every state; what the page never shows her learning (how Kurumi's mother died, Mochiko's private contempt, Yasuko's 2013 history) stays unknown to her in every state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Mochiko as idolized senior, then lender who lied, then teasing equal; Kurumi as the senior she depends on, resents, then protects; Yasuko as neighbour and closest everyday friend whom she ranks below her in 2014; her mother, father and brother; salon customers; a stranger confronted on a friend's behalf. Another peer is a separate, lower-confidence transfer; Kizuna, Nana, the 2017 circle and romantic partners are unsampled.
setting_constraints: Contemporary Japan within her located circumstances, 2014-2015: her flat and Yasuko's next door, the university town and its cafés, the family home in a Kansai-speaking region, the overseas high-leverage FX account of 2014, the loan office, the salon, the circle's dinners, and the 2015 domestic account.

No real market history, no market outcome invented to settle a prediction, no event after autumn 2015, no trading in a losing position after V06, no account of her parents' knowledge, no romantic or intimate scene, no cross-series setting, and no claim about a danger to her person built from pages the readings keep as reader dread.

scenario_readiness.note: Bounded extrapolation supported by a conditional profile with support grades, counterconditions and an abstention list, densely sampled in the 2014 loss states. Not READY: the profile is untested, the post-crisis rows rest on one or two scenes, and the authority-advises-exit case is not discriminated. Not NOT_READY: the conditions that change her choices are located and stated.

conditions: Settings sampled by the monograph: her flat and Yasuko's, the arcade, cafés and restaurants, the family dinner table, the Christmas dinner, the takoyaki party in Yasuko's flat, the salon and its customers.

Predict sociable, physical and comic conduct, food as comfort and celebration, snack hoarding from guests, games as her frame of reference, cute animal things, comic grievance, and quick temper at home with her family.
In the 2014 trading states her ordinary conduct is bent by the position (phone-checking, excuses to step away, one meal a day); this is situational, not preference.
Her university life, life after early 2015 and the 2017 circle are not established and are not filled in.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary conduct located across V02-V09, bounded to the sampled settings. Not READY: much of her comedy is drawn and several habits are single instances. Not NOT_READY: the habits and their settings recur with locators.

conditions: Obligations to her family, friends, creditor and customers over money, in a named state.

Predict the located pattern: concealment from her parents justified as sparing them while she knows it does not (V04 i0128); responsibility taken readily with others, even where it is not hers, and self-blame rather than blame of the person who deceived her; honesty about uncertainty when someone else's money depends on her view (V06 i0035); a boundary held under pressure on the kind of work she will do.
Predict outcomes and her stated words, not a deliberative monologue: weighing of obligations is staged once, at the ticket machine.
Moral, political or institutional questions beyond her own ties are not evidenced and are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Her reasoning is on the page in each located case, so bounded prediction of what she says and does is supported. Not READY: deliberation is rarely staged, and the reasons for holding deception and gratitude together are given only in her words. Not NOT_READY: the pattern is consistent across the located cases.

Not assessed: the monograph marks the dimension UNTESTED (section 10) and warns that nothing about her intimate life is to be inferred from the salon job, her clothes or her customers. The evidence boundary is recorded as the intimate-untested known limit. No state is claimed either way, so this records no finding about how she would behave in a romantic situation.

conditions: Her own retail FX trading in a named 2014 state: an overseas account at 500x set up with Mochiko; delegation to Kurumi's calls in V02; high-leverage positions without stops in V03-V05 (a GBP/USD long into a release, then USD/JPY shorts); positions sized to the distance to break-even rather than to the money at risk (V05 i0085-i0087); funding from scholarship, tuition, living money, card credit, a student loan and Mochiko's loan in that order (Study C SC-4, as reported).
Her grasp of what she trades is thin (V02 i0070; V03 i0041) though her margin arithmetic is correct when calm (V03 i0072-i0073, i0110; V04 i0021); predict both.

Her salon work from November 2014: conscientious, procedural, polite, honest about uncertainty with a customer, firm about time, privately irritated by boors (V06 i0016-i0042; V08 i0097-i0109). The nature of the treatments is unresolved (V05-U19) and is not described.

The autumn 2015 domestic account and rand position: a hearsay-thin carry rationale and an unspecified plan for a fall (V09 i0115-i0117); size, direction and outcome are unprinted and are not generated; abstain on her conduct in a losing position after V06.
scenario_readiness.note: Located professional conduct as a 2014 trader and as a salon worker. Not READY: her trading after V06 is one scene with no printed size or outcome, and her salon work is sampled in a few scenes. Not NOT_READY: the trading chain and the work conduct recur with locators.

known_limits.statement: Section 13 states that its operational profile is a reading aid, not a validated reconstruction model, and confers no reconstruction capability; no held-out test of its predictions is reported.

Whether her holding followed a trusted authority or whatever voice licensed holding is not separated: she kept the short after learning that Mochiko had been long (V05 i0145 to V06 i0039), and what she would have done on 15 October had she known the truth is unshown (V03-U05; section 14).

The self-authored, relational and combined readings of her V03 holding and V04 borrowing are kept together (FXK-SYN-C008, C009, C011, C012, as the monograph reports them); the page declines to fix how much Mochiko's lie changed the outcome (sections 8.1 and 14).

Whether her change after the 5 December liquidation was development or release is unsettled: the broker ended her trading, her stance toward work and her two main ties changed, and she was trading again before repayment in autumn 2015 (sections 12 and 14).
How she trades under a stop or in a losing position after V06 is never tested; the size, direction and outcome of the autumn 2015 rand position are unprinted (V09-U06; section 13, Where to abstain).

Several profile rows rest on one or two scenes: same-night re-entry after a forced close, kindness at a low point, contempt then apology toward a lower-ranked friend, a friend in danger, and spare money after hardship (section 13), so predictions there are lower confidence.

Pages that make a danger to her person salient (V04 i0122; V05 i0138; V06 i0025) give no stated intention, plan or act; the accepted readings keep them as reader dread and trader's idiom, and no claim about her is built from them (sections 6 and 14).

Her voice is lettering; Kansai aloud under pressure rests on two instances, one a MODERATE attribution (V03 i0120); whether the V03 i0084 lines to Yasuko are speech or thought is unresolved; no Kansai is lettered in V08, which one volume does not explain (section 7).

The page never shows her learning how Kurumi's mother died, Mochiko's private contempt, Yasuko's 2013 history or the full extent of Kurumi's crisis beyond Mochiko's January account, so her responses to them are abstentions (section 3).

The monograph marks the romantic and intimate dimension UNTESTED and warns that nothing about her intimate life is to be inferred from the salon job, her clothes or her customers (section 10). This is an evidence boundary, not a finding about romantic behavior.
She does not appear in the V09 2017 coda or in V10; nothing after autumn 2015 is evidence about her, and her life in 2017 is not scoreable (sections 1 and 13).

The volume readings, the decision and evidence ledger, Studies B and C and the audits that carry the underlying observations are not curated on this subject, so every claim here rests on the portrait's summaries and locators.

What she told her parents on 5 December and what they know, the mechanism of her 13 August zero, the total she repaid and the interest she paid, her card terms and student-loan rate, whether she returned to university, and where she works and lives after autumn 2015 are not printed.
